_note: Presentation colours (0-255) the core draws with. players: the four lobby slots' colours. gallery: the Gallery's light, floor and turntable. sun_dir points toward the sun, in hundredths.

lake._note: The lake's look (crates/core/src/scene/look.rs): an overcast northern lake. light.fog is the horizon and the fog; zenith the sky overhead; sky_band where the sky turns between them (hundredths of the view's height). The fog thickens from fog_start_pct of the map's sight distance (sight_mm) and is whole at fog_end_pct. Colours 0-255, lengths mm, shares percent. under: what lies under the surface takes on its colour with depth, so a fish just under shows through the water tinted. water.alpha_*: the surface's opacity looking straight down and at a grazing angle. props name the model for each thing the map places.

title._note: The menus' lake backdrop (crates/core/src/app/title.rs). It shows the checked map at map_index in the map list until another lake has been drawn (a match's, the Lake preview's). The camera's point moves along the lake's tour at drift_pct of the tour's speed, from start_ms of the tour; the camera stands back_mm behind it and pivot_mm over it, pitch_deg down, aims ahead_mm beyond it and aim_mm up, and sways round it by up to sway_deg either side once each sway_ms. boats: each lead_ms of the tour ahead of the camera's point (negative: behind) and side_mm left of the tour (negative: right), in the player colour of its slot (0 blue, 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow).

fishing._note: How the fishing is drawn (crates/core/src/app/fishing.rs). From the boat camera a fish under the water is drawn fish_scale_pct of its size and at fish_depth_pct of its depth, so it reads from nine metres back (SECOND-ORDER R2.38, R3.6); the bobber and lure are drawn bobber_scale_pct and lure_scale_pct of life. The line is line_mm wide from the boat camera and line_under_mm under the water, in the line colour. A landed fish hangs landed_drop_mm under the rod's tip. under: the underwater camera, back_mm behind the lure and up_mm above it, looking pitch_deg down; the murk is colour, fading in from fog_start_pct of fog_mm, with a lighter zenith overhead, and things deeper than the lure tint toward colour by up to tint_pct over clear_mm. It stays clear_surface_mm under the surface and clear_bed_mm over the bed. pip: the picture-in-picture of the boat in the top-left corner, width_pct of the screen wide, tall_pct as tall as it is wide, margin_pct from the corner, with a white border border_permille thousandths of the screen wide.
